note: Frozen before any prospective result was graded. Do not edit. A change requires a new file and a new id; old rows stay under this id.
edge_definition: picked_edge = P_model(model_pick) - P_pinnacle_fair(same outcome). Units are probability, so 3 percentage points = 0.03.
stake: flat 1. Win profit = decimal_odds - 1. Loss profit = -1. No Kelly.
odds_used: Pinnacle decimal converted from the American moneyline on the public guest feed, period 0 (full match), status open, snapshot_timestamp_utc < kickoff_utc. Not Bet365 prices shown on the FootInsights page. Not a post-kickoff price.
closing_definition: Derived at analysis time only: the latest valid Pinnacle snapshot with odds_snapshot_utc < kickoff_utc. Never backfill a price taken after kickoff.

strategies.S3: Bet model_pick iff model_pick == pinnacle_favorite AND model_pick_probability >= 0.50
strategies.S4: Bet model_pick iff model_pick == pinnacle_favorite AND model_pick_probability >= 0.60
strategies.S5: Bet model_pick iff model_pick_probability >= 0.50 AND picked_edge > 0
strategies.S6: Bet model_pick iff model_pick_probability >= 0.60 AND picked_edge > 0

baselines.B1: Bet pinnacle favorite on every matched pre-match row
baselines.B2: Bet pinnacle favorite on the same matches selected by S1
baselines.B3: Bet pinnacle favorite on the same matches selected by S2

exploratory_rule: Any pattern that is not S1-S9 is exploratory. It cannot be declared confirmed on the same rows. It may be tested only on snapshots taken after it is written down.
